meta.name: self-customize
meta.description: Customize your own agent — add capabilities, install packages, add MCP servers, edit code or CLAUDE.md. Use when the user asks you to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how you work. For non-trivial code changes, delegate to a builder agent via create_agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义你的智能体，添加功能、安装包或修改配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按需调整智能体的能力和行为
copy.tagline_en: Customize your agent by adding capabilities, packages, or modifying configs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to tailor your agent's abilities and behavior on demand

howto.what: Claude 可自行修改工作环境：直接编辑记忆或指令、安装系统或全局包、添加 MCP 服务器等；代码改动则交由 builder 代理处理。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加功能、安装工具或修改 Claude 的工作方式时触发。

say.text: 帮我加一个能订阅 RSS 的工具。
安装一下 ffmpeg 和 transformers 包。
say.note: Claude 会请求管理员批准，批准后重建镜像并重启容器。

say.text: 以后改代码前先问我要不要委派 builder。
say.note: Claude 会把这条偏好写进工作指令。

howto.what_en: Claude can customize itself: edit memory/instructions, install system or global npm packages, add MCP servers, etc.; code changes are delegated to a builder agent.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how Claude works.

say_en.text: Help me add a tool that can subscribe to RSS.
say_en.note: Claude checks for an MCP server, else delegates to a builder.

say_en.text: Install ffmpeg and the transformers package.
say_en.note: Claude requests admin approval, then rebuilds and restarts.

say_en.text: Before changing code, ask me if I want to delegate to a builder.
say_en.note: Claude will add this preference to its working instructions.
